Class VerifyCudaGraphSession

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.engine.VerifyCudaGraphSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class VerifyCudaGraphSession extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Per-device CUDA graph session for the uniform MTP window-verify forward.

Graphs are bucketed by (batch, windowLen, numPages) — unlike DecodeCudaGraphSession (implicit S == 1), verify's query length is a real bucket dimension. Within a bucket, the flat KV write-index buffer and CSR metadata are updated in place before replay(int).

Stage 4 of the verify-CUDA-graph plan drives this session's shouldCapture(int, int, int, int) bookkeeping against real traffic while VerifyCudaGraph.captureEnabled() is false, so beginCapture(int) is never actually invoked yet — only bucket-key transitions and warmup counting are exercised for real.
